stream: government / Census / exact schema and category locator verification
purpose: Strengthen the official ORGI Jharkhand C-17 evidence from table-level identification to a reproducible schema/category locator audit while withholding every numeric population value until the declared workbook is acquired byte-preservingly, independently hashed, opened, and exact worksheet/cell coordinates are verified.

source.title: C-17: Population by bilingualism and trilingualism, Jharkhand - 2011
source.producer: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India

verified_schema.table_description: For each mother tongue, the table reports speakers and classifies bilingual and trilingual speakers by the two additional languages spoken.
declared_columns: Total speakers of languages - Language code
Total speakers of languages - Language name
Total speakers of languages - Person / Male / Female
Number of speakers speaking subsidiary languages (1st language) - Language code
Number of speakers speaking subsidiary languages (1st language) - 1st subsidiary languages
Number of speakers speaking subsidiary languages (1st language) - Person / Male / Female
Number of speakers speaking subsidiary languages (2nd language) - Language code
Number of speakers speaking subsidiary languages (2nd language) - 2nd subsidiary languages
Number of speakers speaking subsidiary languages (2nd language) - Person / Male / Female

integrity_and_rights_boundary.note: The first-party catalogue is sufficient to verify table identity, declared workbook filename, state scope, schema headings, and the existence of MUNDA/MUNDARI labels in total/first-subsidiary/second-subsidiary categories. It is not sufficient to assert any numeric value or exact spreadsheet coordinate.

deduplication.reason_count_neutral: This cycle strengthens an already audited official source identity; it does not establish equivalence with an unresolved WEB-MUN lead or create a new source work-family.

promotion.level: first-party table identity + declared workbook + full schema headings + MUNDA/MUNDARI category locators

explicit_gaps: Byte-preserving acquisition of DDW-C17-2000.XLSX from the official download path
Independent cryptographic hash, MIME/container and file-size verification
Exact MUNDA/MUNDARI row numbers and Person/Male/Female cell coordinates
Independent cross-check of extracted numeric cells before any demographic claim enters SOURCE→EVIDENCE→CLAIM
Rights/reuse statement appropriate to any redistributed derivative beyond citation and locator metadata
